visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Rotate with Modulo in One Function
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array is rotated one step at a time inside nested loops. Write a rotate_left function that places each element directly using the modulo operator. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Rotating by k one step at a time costs n * k moves. Element i of the result is simply a[(i + k) % n], so a single pass places everything, and the function works for any k.
